committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 18 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid Search spend fell to A$32.24 last7 from A$152.58 prior7 and clicks dropped to 5 from 21, while total sessions fell to 33 last7 from 52 prior7 (-37%). The A$600 test credit is now at A$0 remaining and campaignStatus shows PAUSED.

No outside Google Ads changes are recorded in the last 24 hours or 7 days (externalLast24h and externalLast7d both 0, status ok), so the 108 raw paid clicks and A$754.48 ex-GST logged in the landing-page test are not contaminated by edits outside the account.

Since the test started, ask_cta_click sits at 17 against quick_question_click at 5 and review_cta_click still at 0, so the short question form is the one drawing raw interest while the deeper booking step has not been used at all.

AI Assistant sessions stayed at 0 for both last7 and prior7 with no top source to name, and Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, held flat at 9 sessions versus 9 prior7 while paid clicks collapsed.

actions.text: The test credit is exhausted (creditRemainingExGst A$0 of A$600), so the decision point is live: paid search stays paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review. campaignStatus already reads PAUSED, consistent with no confirmed qualified booking yet.

Raw paid clicks on the landing page have reached 108, past the 75 mark. Chris should check the hand-kept test log now: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag applies. The page itself stays frozen since it passed click 25.

eventsSinceStart.generate_lead shows 3 submissions since the test began. Chris should check the Formspree and Cal.com email for each one's source and grade it against the qualified rule: a real business, a repeatable admin process and at least one named system.
Standing open item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still needed.
Standing open item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
